## 2026-09-03 — V-107 PREREG: can REDUNDANT extraction beat the recall-squared penalty? (user-directed: "这个有办法解决一下吗"; BLIND on P2-P5; no training)

**The bottleneck, stated as the equation it now is.** V-106 settled the "how to USE evidence" half: given facts, the
sharded store beats the best-configured LLM route and the margin grows with scale. The open half is acquisition.
There the store route loses to a LoRA fine-tune by ~25 points (V-98 extract_ft_10k EM .4678 blind, recall .6589;
V-103 same adapters EM .4722, recall .66; against lora_only .7333 at V-99's 10k configuration), and V-97's P4
established WHY quantitatively: **accuracy tracks recall squared** (measured gaps .028 / .021 / .034 / .024, always
just above the square). Two hops must both survive, so every point lost in extraction costs two end to end.
V-98 already showed recall scaling is real but SUBLINEAR, and chain-weighting was ruled out; so more data does not
reach the derived target (recall .798 to match .6367, .856 to match .7333).

**The lever this tests: attack the EXPONENT, not the recall.** The square arises from two premises — both hops must
be right, and there is ONE candidate path. Draw k extractions of the same passages and union them into the store,
and a hop fails only when ALL k candidates fail: per-hop survival goes from r to 1-(1-r)^k, and accuracy to
(1-(1-r)^k)^2 — **if the failures are independent.** They may well not be: if the model systematically picks the
same wrong relation or the same wrong surface form, resampling reproduces the error k times and buys nothing.
V-103 decomposed the losses into relation choice, answer form and identity but never measured whether any of them
is stochastic. That is the question.

**And redundancy has a price this must measure, not assume.** Every extra candidate also puts more wrong objects
into the store, and the cleanup is an argmax over the objects present — so coverage and cleanup ambiguity move in
opposite directions. Capacity is not the binding constraint here (unions run ~2-24 triples against a k* of ~128 at
d = 2048, V-101), the cleanup's candidate set is.

**Design (v107.py; scorer v107_score.py committed with this entry, before any dump). NO TRAINING.** V-103's saved
adapters `extract_ft_10k_{42,123,456}` (/path/to/pace-scratch/v103_adapters/, 59 MB each) are reused, so
this is inference only. Protocol inherited verbatim from v103_train.py's eval path: Qwen3-8B + adapter,
`ex_prompt` (EX_INSTR = "Extract every fact from the context as `subject | relation | object`, one per line. Use
the exact surface forms from the context.") over the instance's own passages at budget 1200, max_new 320,
`ST.parse_triples`, hash identity (n_rows 200003, d 2048), exact two-hop `ST.answer_two_hop`, entry point
`head_entity(row)`, eval `load_rows(300, "validation")`, metric `em`, recall = `ST.triple_recall` on
(subject, object) pairs with relations ignored. Three seeds, each with its own adapter.

Arms:
- `greedy` — k = 1, `do_sample=False`. This is the gate arm.
- `sampled k ∈ {1, 2, 4, 8}` — eight samples drawn ONCE per row in a single batched call
  (`num_return_sequences=8`, temperature 0.8, top_p 0.95), with k = 1, 2, 4 taken as nested prefixes of those
  eight. Nested by construction, so the k-trend is internally consistent and the whole sweep costs one generation
  pass. Triples are unioned and deduplicated on the normalised (subject, relation, object).

**Temperature 0.8 / top_p 0.95 are fixed here and were NOT tuned.** No sweep over them was run or will be; a
post-hoc temperature search would make any lift unfalsifiable.

**Predictions.**
- **P1 gate:** `greedy` reproduces V-103's extract_ft_10k at its own configuration (same adapters, same protocol,
  same 300 unfiltered validation rows, budget 1200, max_new 320, metric `em`): EM within .05 of .4722 AND recall
  within .05 of .66. A miss means the adapter or the protocol was not reconstructed and nothing is read.
- **P2 (are the failures stochastic?):** recall(k=8) ≥ recall(k=1 sampled) + .10.
- **P3 (does the mechanism survive redundancy?):** EM(k) is within .10 of recall(k)^2 at every k ∈ {1,2,4,8}.
- **P4 (does it propagate?):** EM(k=8) ≥ EM(k=1 sampled) + .05.
- **P5 (descriptive, no bar):** triples per row at each k; the count of distinct wrong objects entering the store;
  and a diagnostic on the INHERITED protocol — how often `head_entity` falls back to `cands[0]`, i.e. supplies a
  gold subject that does not appear in the question. Its docstring claims the entry point is "derived from the
  QUESTION text, not from gold objects", which is true of the answer but not of the candidate set, and the
  fallback's frequency has never been measured on a protocol the manuscript relies on.

**Readings, fixed now.**
- **P2 ∧ P4:** redundancy is a real lever on the acquisition bottleneck. Report the resulting EM against
  lora_only .7333 (V-99's 10k configuration) and state how much of the ~25-point gap it closes — and, if P3 also
  holds, that the closure is exactly the exponent effect. NEXT PAPER; nothing enters 9/16.
- **P2 hit, P4 fail:** coverage rises and accuracy does not, so the added candidates cost in cleanup ambiguity what
  they gain in coverage. Redundancy-as-stated is dead, and the recall-squared model needs a store-noise term it
  does not have. **Reported before anything else**, because it would be the second time this project found a
  remedy whose price cancels its gain (V-99's routing was the first).
- **P2 fail:** the extraction failures are SYSTEMATIC, not stochastic — resampling reproduces them. Sampling is
  then the wrong lever entirely and the honest next move is changing the extraction target or schema, not drawing
  more samples. This outcome also retires the redundancy idea I proposed to the user, and I will say so.
- **P3 fail with P2 and P4 holding:** the gain is real but not via the claimed mechanism; it is NOT attributed to
  the exponent, and the alternative account is left open rather than invented.
- **P1 fail:** adapter or protocol mismatch. Investigated first; nothing read.

**Scoping.** This is the ACQUISITION half: the store must obtain its own facts from text. These numbers are not
comparable to V-106's gold-triple sweep and do not bear on it. Whatever happens, the manuscript's boundary
statements (identity must be supplied; extraction is the binding constraint) stand unless P4 hits, in which case
the second one is quantified rather than overturned.

**I am blind on P2, P3, P4 and P5.** No sampled or redundant extraction has ever been run in this project; every
extraction number on record is greedy, single-pass.

**Stop: 1 calendar day.** Compute: PACE Phoenix gpu-h200, account gts-nimam6 (free tier). No writes to
/path/to/pace-project/r-nimam6-0. **Nothing enters the 9/16 submission** — 13 days out, and the V-106 fold already
spent this week's one override.

## 2026-09-04 — V-108 PREREG: does the paper's headline conclusion survive PARAMETER SCALE? (advisor-directed: N.I. wants the good conclusions retested at 30B / 300B and beyond; BLIND on P2-P5)

**The claim under test, quoted with its full configuration** (main_npj.tex ~line 449-464): 2WikiMultihopQA, 300
compositional two-hop dev instances, frozen model throughout, exact match after standard normalisation, the dataset
supplies gold evidence triples and every answer appears among them (coverage 1.000), so the arms differ only in HOW
the same evidence reaches the model.
- `single_pass` — few-shot prompting over the passages: **Phi-2 .253**
- `evidence_in_prompt` — the same gold triples verbalised: **Phi-2 .950**
- `store` — the same triples in an HRR store, string-identity codes, two unbind-and-cleanup hops: **.970–.977
  across codebook seeds, mean .974**
- headline: (.974 − .253)/(1 − .253) = 96.5% ≈ **97% of single-pass errors removed**
- the paper's own existing scale points: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct `single_pass` **.227** (WORSE than Phi-2 at 2.7x the
  parameters); Qwen3-8B `single_pass` **.397**, `evidence_in_prompt` **.953**, store still removes **96%**.
- the paper's own reading of those points: "two-hop composition is not bought by parameter count within a
  generation, though partly by a newer one."

**What scale can and cannot touch, and why this experiment is small.** The store arm uses string-identity codes and
random vectors and never touches the model — the paper says its .974 is "model-independent by construction". So the
store is NOT re-measured at any scale; there is nothing in it that a bigger model could change. Only the two LLM
arms move. The scale question is therefore exactly: **how far does `single_pass` rise, and does
`evidence_in_prompt` overtake the store?** Two API-measurable numbers per model, no hidden states, no training.

**This also settles what CANNOT be tested this way, stated so it is not quietly skipped.** The manuscript's main
pipeline couples the model through a supervised identity head on hidden states. API models expose no hidden states,
so that pipeline cannot be reproduced at scale through an API at all. Testing it at 30B would need local weights on
one H200 (a 32B in bf16 is ~64 GB, feasible); at 300B+ it is not feasible and the hidden states are unavailable
anyway. V-108 deliberately tests only the part that scale can touch, and the limitation is reported with the result.

**Two sharp falsification thresholds, fixed now.** The headline degrades gracefully rather than falling off a
cliff, because the store's ceiling is .974: even a baseline of .90 leaves (.974−.90)/(1−.90) = 74% error removal.
The claim actually dies only when a model crosses the store:
- **T1: `single_pass` > .974** ⇒ the model beats the store unaided; the core premise dies at that scale.
- **T2: `evidence_in_prompt` > .974** ⇒ "the algebra halves the residual error, 5.0% to 2.6%" dies.

**Ladder.** Within one family, to control the training recipe, using published parameter counts:
`qwen/qwen3-8b` (the gate) → `qwen/qwen3-14b` → `qwen/qwen3-32b` → `qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b` (235B total / 22B
active — total and active are both reported, because a MoE is not a dense scale point). Then frontier, size
undisclosed, named by the advisor: `z-ai/glm-5` and `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash`. A known-405B dense point
(`hermes-3-llama-3.1-405b`) was available and NOT used, because it is a third-party finetune and would confound
scale with recipe; recorded so the omission is a decision.

**Protocol (v108.py; scorer v108_score.py committed with this entry, before any dump).**
One API code path for every model. `load_rows(300, "validation")` — the paper's own 300 rows, unfiltered.
- `single_pass` = `v85_data.prompt_for(row, tok, 1200)` — the paper's few-shot-over-passages arm.
- `evidence_in_prompt` = `v106.facts_prompt(own_gold_triples, question)` — the FEWSHOT + `Facts:` template
  committed in v106.py, which is gate-verified (V-106 P1c reproduced V-100's licensed .9417 at .9500, and its
  pre-flight token prediction matched the run to 3 tokens).
- **The context for every model is built with the Qwen3-8B tokenizer**, so the evidence bytes are identical across
  the ladder and only the model varies. Stated because it is a choice: a per-model tokenizer would change the
  evidence with the model and confound the comparison.
- temperature 0, max_tokens 16, first line taken, metric `v85_data.em`.
- The serving provider returned by OpenRouter is recorded per call and reported if it varied within a model, since
  routing can change the served weights.
- Spend cap **USD 25**, hard-stopped in the script; measured spend reported.

**Predictions (bars).**
- **P1 gate:** `qwen/qwen3-8b` through this API path reproduces the paper's Qwen3-8B row — `single_pass` within .05
  of .397 AND `evidence_in_prompt` within .05 of .953. A miss means the API path or a template differs from the
  paper's and nothing is read.
- **P2:** every model on the ladder has `single_pass` < .974 (T1 not crossed).
- **P3:** every model has `evidence_in_prompt` < .974 (T2 not crossed).
- **P4:** within the Qwen3 family `single_pass` rises monotonically across all three steps 8B → 14B → 32B → 235B.
- **P5 (descriptive, no bar):** the error-removal percentage (.974 − single_pass)/(1 − single_pass) per model. This
  is the number the experiment exists to produce and predicting it would be guessing.

**My expected directions, stated separately from the bars so that hindsight is impossible.** I expect **P2 to
hold** (the passages still have to be read and the composition still has to be executed). I expect **P3 to FAIL** —
at 8B `evidence_in_prompt` is already .953, only .021 below the store, and a frontier model has ample room to pass
.974. I am **uncertain on P4**, and note that a P4 failure would CONFIRM the paper's own "not bought by parameter
count within a generation" line rather than contradict it.

**Readings, fixed now.**
- **P2 ∧ P3 hold:** the headline survives scale across a 30x span of published parameters plus two frontier models.
  The paper gains a scale-robustness statement, which is the strongest form the claim has had.
- **P2 holds, P3 fails (my expectation):** the *error-removal* headline survives, but "the algebra halves the
  residual error, 5.0% to 2.6%" is a small-model claim. **Reported before the surviving half.** The sentence then
  needs exactly the qualification the bulky-evidence paragraph already received after V-100 — and per that
  precedent the qualification is **proposed to the co-author, not applied unilaterally**, because it edits a claim
  sentence 12 days from the deadline.
- **P2 fails for any model:** that model beats the store unaided. The core premise dies at that scale; the model
  and its number are named plainly, and the paper needs a scope statement naming the model class it holds for.
  This outcome is reported first and without softening.
- **P4 fails:** confirms the manuscript's existing claim; NOT written up as a negative result.
- **P1 fails:** path or template mismatch; investigated first, nothing read.

**Scoping.** This is the GOLD-triple setting. It says nothing about acquisition, where the end-to-end route sits at
.4678 against a fine-tune's .7333 (V-98/V-99) and where V-107 is currently testing redundancy. It also does not
re-measure the store, for the reason given above.

**I am blind on P2, P3, P4 and P5.** No model above 8B has been run on this protocol by us, ever.

**Stop: 1 calendar day.** Compute: OpenRouter API from the Phoenix login node (no GPU, no PACE allocation spent).
Nothing enters the 9/16 submission without the usual banking, tracing and checker chain — with the P3 exception
handled as stated above.

### 2026-09-04 — V-108 PREREG CORRECTION, before any scored call (smoke test on 5 rows caught an interface confound)

A 5-row smoke on the gate model exposed three confounds between the API path and the protocol that produced the
banked numbers, none of which is scale. The paper's Qwen3-8B .397/.953 were measured by RAW COMPLETION of the
few-shot prompt: max_new_tokens=16, greedy, no chat template, no reasoning. Every OpenRouter endpoint is a chat
endpoint and Qwen3 ships with thinking ON, so: (1) 250-350 reasoning tokens are spent before any answer, (2) at
max_tokens=16 the content came back EMPTY and scored 0/5 -- an instrument artefact, not a capability reading, and
(3) answers arrive as prose ("Answer: 12 June 1516", "**Malgorzata Braunek**") that exact match rejects even when
the substance is right. Row 0 was substantively correct and scored zero.

Left uncorrected, P1 would have failed for reasons unrelated to the question and the money would have bought
nothing. Corrected as follows, with the principle stated: **give the baseline every advantage**, which is the
conservative direction when the experiment tests whether OUR claim survives.
- an explicit entity-only instruction prepended to the single_pass arm (this STRENGTHENS the baseline);
- max_tokens 16 -> 512, room for reasoning and an answer;
- one surface normalisation, `surface()`, fixed in code before any scored call and never tuned per model: take the
  last non-empty line, strip a leading "answer is:", strip markdown emphasis and surrounding quotes.
- reasoning left at each model's default, since a thinking baseline is the strongest baseline.

**P1's status changes and I say so rather than quietly keeping it.** Against a chat+thinking endpoint the .397 is no
longer a reproduction target -- it was produced by a weaker interface. P1 becomes a DIRECTIONAL sanity gate:
qwen3-8b's single_pass under this protocol must be >= .397, and if it is BELOW that the protocol is handicapping the
model and nothing is read. The falsification thresholds T1 and T2 are unchanged, because crossing the store's .974
does not depend on the anchor.

**Ladder refined on the user's direction ("逐步来", finer steps).** Dense Qwen3 trio 8B -> 14B -> 32B is the clean
scale statement (one family, one recipe). MoE rungs 30B-A3B, 80B-A3B, 122B-A10B, 235B-A22B, 397B-A17B are a
SEPARATE series, with total and active parameters both reported, because they are different axes. Frontier rungs
GLM-5 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash have undisclosed sizes.

**Difficulty escalation registered as a POLICY, not yet as a design.** The user asked for harder tasks at larger
models. Done naively that moves two variables at once and no statement about scale survives -- the same confound
structure as the interface problem above. So: one FIXED core task across every rung (this run), and harder tiers
added only where the core saturates, each harder tier run on at least two ADJACENT rungs so it is anchored by
overlap. The dials will be the two continuous ones we already own with banked store curves -- evidence scale
(V-106: store flat .936->.908 while prompting decays .950->.542) and chain depth (paper: .998/.997/.972/.951/.934)
-- rather than swapping datasets, so that "harder" is a measured number. The harder tiers are NOT designed here:
where saturation falls is exactly what this run measures, and designing them first would be guessing.

### 2026-09-04 — V-108 DEVIATION (infrastructure, no protocol change): the ladder split across two jobs

The rungs turned out to take wildly different wall-clock: qwen3-8b 9.6 min, qwen3-14b 7.8 min, but qwen3-32b
**~65 min** for the same 600 calls. Cause is provider-side throughput, not the harness: zero call errors, all 300
rows scored per arm, and the account's cumulative usage climbed steadily throughout (~$1.6/hour), so calls were
landing the whole time. At ~60 min/rung the remaining seven rungs needed about seven hours against under seven
left on an eight-hour wall.

Handled the way V-105's wall-clock shortfall was: a second job (12797968, `v108b`) runs the LAST three rungs
(qwen3.5-397b-a17b, z-ai/glm-5, deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash) into `v108_logs/v108b.json` while 12794823 continues
through the middle rungs. **Nothing about the registered protocol changes** — same script, same prebuilt prompts
(identical bytes, built once from the Qwen3-8B tokenizer), temperature 0, same surface normalisation, same 300
rows. The two dumps merge on model id; if the first job reaches a rung the second already did, the duplicate is
discarded and the discard is printed, following v105_merge.py's precedent of a deterministic, pre-stated rule.

**Reproducibility caveat found while running, and registered to be reported.** The qwen3-14b rung was served by
THREE different providers within one arm (Alibaba, DeepInfra, NextBit). A nominal model id on OpenRouter does not
pin the served weights or their quantisation, so that rung's number is a mixture. The prereg registered
"record the provider per call and report if it varied" rather than pinning, so I am NOT changing the running
sweep — changing it now would make the completed rungs incomparable. Reported as a limitation, and pinning the
provider is named as the fix for any future run.

**A second instrument note, for the cost axis only.** The dump's per-call `usage.cost` summed to $0.2199 after two
rungs while the account's cumulative usage read $1.4296 during the third. The two sources are not obviously
reconcilable, so at scoring time both are reported and no cost claim rests on either alone. The accuracy readings
are unaffected: they come from `em` on the returned text, not from the billing fields.

## 2026-09-04 — V-107 CLOSED: P1 gate hit, P2 HIT, **P3 and P4 MISS** — redundancy buys coverage and the cleanup gives it all back. The lever I proposed is dead as stated.

Prereg a32be1b (hash stamped into the dump), scorer `v107_score.py` committed with it and run verbatim. Phoenix
gpu-h200, 1:50:46, no training (V-103's saved `extract_ft_10k_{42,123,456}` adapters reused). Artifacts banked:
`v107_logs/v107.json`, `v107_logs/v107_score.txt`, code `v107.py` / `v107_score.py` / `v107.sbatch`, job log.

| arm | EM | recall | recall² | triples/row | distinct wrong objects/row |
|-----|------|--------|---------|-------------|----------------------------|
| greedy | .4778 | .6633 | .4400 | 2.00 | — |
| k=1 | .4344 | .6333 | .4011 | 2.00 | 0.57 |
| k=2 | .4378 | .6994 | .4892 | 2.52 | 0.81 |
| k=4 | .4256 | .7494 | .5617 | 3.16 | 1.16 |
| k=8 | .4278 | **.7872** | .6197 | 3.86 | 1.50 |

Per-seed spreads are tight (k=8 EM .4267/.4267/.4300; k=8 recall .785/.7767/.800), so nothing here rests on one seed.

**P1 HIT.** Greedy reproduces V-103's extract_ft_10k at its own configuration: EM .4778 vs .4722, recall .6633 vs
.66, both inside ±.05, same adapters and same eval path. The harness is the one that produced the banked numbers.

**P2 HIT, and it answers the question it was built for.** recall(k=8) − recall(k=1) = .7872 − .6333 = **+.1539**
against a .10 bar. **The extraction failures are stochastic, not systematic**: resampling the same passages does
find triples the greedy pass missed. That was the genuinely uncertain half of the design and it came out positive.

**P4 MISS — and this is the result.** EM(k=8) − EM(k=1) = .4278 − .4344 = **−.0067** against a +.05 bar. Coverage
rose fifteen points and accuracy did not move at all.

**P3 MISS, and its pattern names the mechanism.** |EM − recall²| was registered at ≤ .10 for every k; measured
deviations run +.0333, −.0514, −.1361, **−.1919**. EM falls progressively further BELOW recall² as k grows, and the
last column says why: distinct wrong objects per row climb 0.57 → 1.50 as triples per row climb 2.00 → 3.86. Every
extra candidate is another competitor in front of the cleanup's argmax. **Coverage and cleanup ambiguity cancel,
here almost exactly one for one.**

**The registered reading applies verbatim, and it is the one I have to report first.** "P2 hit, P4 fail: coverage
rises and accuracy does not, so the added candidates cost in cleanup ambiguity what they gain in coverage.
Redundancy-as-stated is dead, and the recall-squared model needs a store-noise term it does not have." This is the
second time in this project a remedy's price cancelled its gain (V-99's abstention routing was the first). **The
lever was mine — I proposed it to the user as the way to beat the recall² penalty, and it does not work.** No
registration defect this time: the outcome landed inside a branch that was written before the run.

**A second observation, unregistered and reported as such.** Greedy (.4778) beats every sampled arm, including
k=1 sampled (.4344) which differs from greedy only by decoding at T=0.8. So stochastic decoding costs ~.043 of EM
outright, and redundancy never earns it back — k=8 is still .050 below greedy. Sampling is not free here.

**Where this leaves the bottleneck, stated as a redirection rather than a rescue.** At k=8 the store holds the
right pair for 78.7% of gold triples but answers 42.8% correctly. If selection were perfect, recall² alone would
put EM near .62. **So ~.19 of accuracy is already sitting inside the store and is being lost at selection, which
is now a larger prize than pushing recall further.** The bottleneck has moved from acquisition-coverage to
acquisition-*selection*: pruning candidates before they enter the store, or using the cleanup margin to choose
among them, are the natural next tests. Named, NOT registered — designing them here, after seeing the table, is
exactly the hindsight this discipline exists to prevent.

**P5, descriptive, and one item of it is a finding about a protocol the manuscript relies on.** Triples per row
2.00 → 3.86 and wrong objects 0.57 → 1.50 (above). The `head_entity` fallback rate is **.1100**: on 11% of the 300
eval rows the chain's entry point is a gold subject that does NOT appear in the question, because
`v98_train.head_entity` falls back to `cands[0]` when no gold subject matches the question text. Its docstring says
the entry point is "derived from the QUESTION text, not from gold objects — so no answer information enters",
which is true of the answer but not of the candidate set. **This affects every extraction number in the
V-97/98/99/103 line and in V-107 itself, and it had never been measured.** It does not overturn those numbers —
the fallback supplies a starting entity, not an answer — but the claim that no gold information enters the entry
point is too strong as written, and any manuscript sentence resting on it needs checking.

**Blindness — one component of P5 seen before scoring, disclosed.** While checking that the run was past the
adapter load (the Lustre stage where V-106's first launch hung), a grep for stage markers also matched the P5
diagnostic line, so I saw the .1100 fallback rate before the scorer ran. P5 carries no bar and no registered
reading, and the scorer was committed before any dump existed, so no statistic could have been chosen to fit it;
P2/P3/P4 — every prediction with a bar — were unseen. Recorded because the practice is worth nothing if I decide
which lapses count.

**Scoping unchanged.** This is the ACQUISITION half. Not comparable to V-106's gold-triple sweep, which measures
how to USE evidence. The end-to-end store route stays at .4678 (V-98) against a fine-tune's .7333 (V-99), and
V-107 does not close that gap. **Nothing enters the 9/16 submission**, as registered.

## 2026-09-04 — V-108 CLOSED (6 of 10 rungs; credits exhausted): P1 gate PASSES, **P2 and P3 both HOLD**, P4 fails and thereby confirms the manuscript. The 97% headline survives 8B → 122B at 95.0–95.8%. **My own registered expectation on P3 was wrong.**

Prereg 6f3ea10, correction 339e003 (both committed before any scored call), scorer run verbatim after being
brought into line with the correction (see the disclosed lapse below). Artifacts: `v108_logs/v108.json`,
`v108_logs/v108_score.txt`, code `v108.py` / `v108_score.py` / `v108.sbatch` / `v108b.sbatch` / `v108_merge.py`.

| model | params (total/active) | single_pass | evidence_in_prompt | error removed vs store .974 |
|-------|----------------------|-------------|--------------------|------------------------------|
| qwen3-8b | 8B dense | .4700 | .9633 | **95.1%** |
| qwen3-14b | 14B dense | .3800 | .9600 | **95.8%** |
| qwen3-32b | 32B dense | .4633 | .9533 | **95.2%** |
| qwen3-30b-a3b | 30B / 3B | .4367 | .9433 | **95.4%** |
| qwen3-next-80b-a3b | 80B / 3B | .4800 | .9533 | **95.0%** |
| qwen3.5-122b-a10b | 122B / 10B | .4033 | .8863 | **95.6%** |

Banked references, unchanged and not re-measured: store .974 (seed range .970–.977, model-independent by
construction), Phi-2 single_pass .253 / evidence_in_prompt .950, Qwen3-8B .397 / .953.

**P1 gate PASSES in its registered (directional) form**: single_pass .4700 ≥ .397 and evidence_in_prompt .9633
within .05 of .953.

**P2 HOLDS.** No rung crosses T1: single_pass spans .3800–.4800 against the store's .974. Every model on the
ladder still fails two-hop composition from its own passages, so the store still has error to remove.

**P3 HOLDS — and I predicted it would fail.** No rung crosses T2: evidence_in_prompt spans .8863–.9633, all below
.974. The prereg stated separately from the bars: "I expect **P3 to FAIL** — at 8B evidence_in_prompt is already
.953, only .021 below the store, and a frontier model has ample room to pass .974." It did not happen. Within this
ladder the arm does not rise with scale at all; it **declines** slightly, from .9633 at 8B to .8863 at 122B. I was
wrong about the direction, and the reason I wrote the expectation down separately was so this could be checked.

**P4 FAILS, and per the registered reading that CONFIRMS the manuscript rather than contradicting it.** Within the
dense Qwen3 family single_pass runs .4700 (8B) → .3800 (14B) → .4633 (32B): the 8B→14B step is **−.09**. The
paper already says two-hop composition "is not bought by parameter count within a generation, though partly by a
newer one", and the ladder reproduces exactly that non-monotonicity across a 15× span. Not written up as a
negative.

**P5, the number the run existed to produce.** Error removal is **95.0%–95.8%** across all six rungs — a band of
0.8 points across 8B to 122B, dense and MoE alike. The paper's 96.5%-rounded-to-97% figure for Phi-2 is therefore
not a small-model artefact: **the headline is scale-robust in this range, which is the strongest form this claim
has had.** The reason is structural and worth stating: the store's ceiling is .974 and no model in this range gets
near it unaided, so the ratio barely moves.

### Defects and limitations, all of them

**1. I corrected the registration and forgot the code that enforces it.** Correction 339e003 demoted P1 from a
reproduction test (|single_pass − .397| ≤ .05) to a directional gate (≥ .397), because the paper's .397 came from
raw completion with max_new_tokens=16 and no chat template while every OpenRouter endpoint is chat-with-thinking.
I applied that to the prereg text and not to `v108_score.py`. The first scoring run therefore printed "GATE FAILS"
(|.4700 − .397| = .073) — a verdict contradicting the operative registration. Fixed at daf2db0, touching **only
P1**, with both forms printed so the choice is auditable. The correction predates every scored call, so reading
P2–P5 is licensed; the lapse is in bookkeeping, not in moving a bar after seeing data. Recorded because "run the
committed scorer verbatim" is worthless if the committed scorer and the registration disagree.

**2. The spend cap was enforced against an unreliable source and therefore did nothing.** The script capped
spending at USD 25 using the per-call `usage.cost` field, which summed to **$2.51**. The account's own usage for
the same period reads **$19.59 of $20**, roughly **8× higher**. The cap never fired; the credits ran out instead,
which is what stopped the run. I had already noticed the two sources disagreeing ($0.22 vs $1.43) and registered
it as something to *report* — **but I did not notice that the same unreliability had disabled my own fuse.** The
fix for any future run is to poll `/api/v1/credits` and cap on the account balance, never on the response field.
No accuracy reading is affected: those come from `em` on returned text, not from billing fields.

**3. Four rungs were never run, and they are the ones the advisor most wanted.** qwen3.5-397b-a17b,
qwen3-235b-a22b, z-ai/glm-5 and deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash — the several-hundred-billion and frontier points —
stopped at HTTP 402. So the ladder answers 8B→122B and says **nothing** about frontier systems. The claim in this
entry is bounded accordingly, and the missing rungs need about USD 30 of credit, which is the user's call.

**4. A nominal model id does not pin the served weights.** Up to five providers served a single rung
(qwen3.5-122b-a10b: Alibaba, AtlasCloud, DeepInfra, Novita, SiliconFlow; qwen3-next-80b: five as well), so each
rung's number is a mixture over providers and possibly over quantisations. The prereg registered recording and
reporting this rather than pinning, so the running sweep was not changed mid-flight; pinning
`provider: {order, allow_fallbacks: false}` is the fix for any future run.

**5. One arm is 299 rows, not 300** (qwen3.5-122b-a10b evidence_in_prompt) — one 402 during the credit exhaustion.

## 2026-09-04 — V-109 PRE-REGISTERED (before any code): consensus-gated store entry — does candidate frequency across samples separate coverage from cleanup ambiguity?

**Motivation, from V-107's closure verbatim:** at k=8 the store holds the right pair for 78.7% of gold triples yet
answers 42.8% correctly; wrong objects/row climbed 0.57 → 1.50 with k, and EM fell progressively below recall²
— every added candidate is a competitor at the cleanup argmax. V-107 named acquisition-SELECTION as the new
bottleneck and explicitly declined to design its test in the same entry. This registration designs it, on FRESH
extraction runs (the V-107 dump kept only per-arm aggregates, so no selection rule can be scored offline; that
limitation is fixed below). The confound this prereg NAMES (rule 2): in V-107 every sampled candidate entered the
store unweighted. V-109 tests whether cross-sample frequency separates true triples (stochastic recall = the same
true triple recurring across resamples) from spurious ones (errors uncorrelated across resamples). If true triples
do NOT recur, the whole redundancy line closes — that outcome is written down here in advance.

**Mechanism, exact (discipline 4):** per eval row, one greedy pass + k=8 samples at T=0.8 — V-107's configuration
verbatim (same extract_ft_10k_{42,123,456} adapters, no training, same surface normalisation, same 300 rows, same
downstream store-traversal + cleanup-argmax + EM path, untouched). A sampled triple enters the store iff its
normalised (subject, relation, object) appears in ≥ m of the 8 samples. Greedy-pass triples always enter.

**Arms:** greedy-only (gate); union-all (greedy ∪ m≥1); **vote2 (greedy ∪ m≥2) = PRIMARY**; m ∈ {4,6,8} as a
descriptive curve only — no bar rides on them and no post-hoc threshold promotion.

**Bars (3-seed means), fixed now:**
- **P1 gate:** |EM(greedy) − .4778| ≤ .05, else the harness is broken and nothing is read.
- **P2 (mechanism):** distinct wrong objects/row (vote2) ≤ 0.5 × union-all AND recall(vote2) ≥ .70 (note the
  automatic floor at greedy's .6633 since greedy triples always enter; the bar asks consensus-surviving sampled
  triples to add real coverage). FAIL ⇒ stochastic recall gains are unrepeatable one-off flukes; the redundancy
  line (V-107 + V-109) closes entirely.
- **P3 (PRIMARY):** EM(vote2) ≥ EM(greedy) + .03. HIT = first conversion of acquisition redundancy into
  end-to-end accuracy in this project. MISS with P2 hit ⇒ the loss is NOT candidate competition in the store —
  V-107's mechanism reading is falsified and the cleanup step itself becomes the suspect; record verbatim,
  no rescue iteration.
- **P4 (model):** |EM(vote2) − recall(vote2)²| ≤ .10 — pruning should remove the store-noise term that broke the
  recall² model in V-107 (deviations there ran to −.19 at k=8).

**Expectations, stated separately from the bars (V-108 practice — so wrongness is checkable):** I expect P2 to
HIT (T=0.8 errors should be near-uncorrelated across samples) and I treat P3 as genuinely uncertain: V-99 and
V-107 both saw a remedy's price cancel its gain almost exactly, and a third cancellation (consensus pruning
exactly the hard-row triples that carried the coverage) is a live outcome.

**Inherited and disclosed, deliberately unchanged:** the head_entity gold-fallback (.1100, measured in V-107)
stays as-is — fixing it here would move two variables at once; it is reported alongside whatever V-109 finds.

**Dump upgrade, registered:** v109.json retains PER-ROW, PER-SAMPLE normalised extractions, so any future
selection rule (cleanup-margin, frequency-weighted retrieval) can be scored OFFLINE without re-extraction.
V-107's aggregate-only dump is what forced this re-run; that mistake is not repeated.

**Prior-art scoping now, not after:** consensus filtering is self-consistency (Wang et al. 2022) / distant-
supervision consistency filtering transplanted to the store-entry locus. Any positive result is a claim about
THIS pipeline's selection bottleneck, never about the novelty of voting.

### 2026-09-04 — LITERATURE CHECK: "VSA can do reasoning, not just memory" (advisor-directed reading of Kanerva 2009). One of my own framings REFUTED; the direction survives on different grounds.

**What was read.** Kanerva, "Hyperdimensional Computing: An Introduction to Computing in Distributed Representation
with High-Dimensional Random Vectors", Cogn Comput (2009) 1:139-159 (full PDF, all 21 pages), and the analogical
reasoning section (3.1.2) of Kleyko/Rachkovskij/Osipov/Rahimi Survey Part II (arXiv 2112.15424), which the
manuscript already cites as `kleyko2023surveyII`.

**What Kanerva actually shows (pp. 153-155).** Two worked reasoning examples, pure vector arithmetic, no training:
(i) a rule learned from ONE example — 'x mother of y and y father of z implies x grandmother of z' encoded as the
mapping vector R = G_xz * (M_xy + F_yz), which applied to a new antecedent yields the correct grandmother relation
("It is remarkable that learning from a single example would lead to the correct inference"); (ii) the Dollar of
Mexico, where (D*A)*B ~ P recovers 'peso' **without ever explicitly recovering the role variable**.

**The two failure modes Kanerva names are the two this project has since measured.**
- On the rule example he warns that for some relation combinations "the computed inference correlates positively
  with the correct inference but a relation that is a part of the antecedent -- a tautology -- correlates more
  highly", diagnosing it as the mapping including the identity vector. **That is a cleanup-selection failure: the
  right answer is present but a competitor wins the argmax.** V-107 measured exactly this shape — recall .7872
  with EM .4278, i.e. ~.19 of accuracy present in the store and lost at selection.
- On holistic substitution he shows that a mapping computed from one differing role destroys the roles where the
  records agreed ("noise + noise + Z*F"). **That is superposition cross-talk** — the quantity behind V-95's .0989
  threshold and the capacity work in V-101/V-102.

**My framing to the user was WRONG on the novelty question, and the check is why.** I said the natural
contribution was that "nobody has quantified when analogical mapping survives". The survey shows a mature
subfield: Plate modelled analogical RETRIEVAL against the psychological similarity types; SBDR work reproduced it;
one study evaluated on the leading models' own test bases and reported higher recall and "a noticeable increase in
the precision" at lower computational cost; for MAPPING there is DRAMA (HRR) plus SBDR techniques demonstrated on
the hard classic analogies ("Water Flow-Heat Flow", "Solar System-Atom", "Schools") that "produced the correct
mapping results", with analogical inference also considered. **The phenomenon is old and the benchmarks are
occupied.**

**The survey also deflates the specific demo.** It describes the Dollar of Mexico as solving "simple 'proportional
analogies' of the form A:B :: C:D", noting these "are also known to be solvable by addition and subtraction of the"
word vectors — i.e. the word2vec king-man+woman class, the easiest kind. It must not be led with.

**What the check leaves standing, and it is sharper than what I started with.** The same section names two open
problems verbatim: holistic-transformation mapping "was **not demonstrated to be scalable to large analogical
episodes**", and "current models of HDC/VSA for analogical mapping **lack interaction and competition of consistent
alternative mappings**", improvable "by using an approach involving the associative memory". Those are a capacity
question and a cleanup-competition question — the two quantities this project already has instruments for
(k* ~ d/const and per-shard capacity from V-101/V-102; the .0989 cross-talk threshold from V-95; and V-107's
measurement of exactly how much accuracy selection loses). **So the contribution would be in the MEASUREMENT, not
in the phenomenon**, and any writing must say so.

**Consequence for the current manuscript: none, and one exposure checked and cleared.** thm:capacity is already
attributed to `plate1995holographic,frady2018theory` and the text already states that both framing theorems "are
due to the sources cited and neither is a contribution of this work". Clarkson, Ubaru & Yang, "Capacity Analysis of
Vector Symbolic Architectures" (arXiv 2301.10352) bounds the dimension needed for SET MEMBERSHIP and SET
INTERSECTION SIZE, a different task from two-hop unbind-and-cleanup, so it does not collide; worth citing if the
capacity paragraph is ever expanded.

**Status: direction NAMED, not registered.** The obvious first test — does the .0989 threshold predict when
analogical mapping succeeds, as it predicts every arena row — needs a prereg, and it also needs the relation slot
the current store discards (`bind(hash(subject), hash(object))`, relation dropped), so it is a change to the store
and not merely a new experiment. Nothing about it enters the 9/16 submission.

## 2026-09-04 — V-110 PRE-REGISTERED (before any code): READ-side selection over the V-109 dump — does per-key candidate frequency convert stored coverage into EM where entry gating could not?

**Motivation, from V-109's closure verbatim:** no store-ENTRY rule over the V-107 generation config converts
redundancy's coverage gain (+.075 recall over greedy at vote2, union recall ~.79) into EM — the whole m-curve is
EM <= greedy, and V-107's ~.19 of accuracy sits inside the store and is lost at selection. The closure named the
next bid: act at the READ side, scoreable OFFLINE from v109.json's registered per-row per-sample dump (md5
4854bdf8cde14e8e55508ad81f08f7b8), no re-extraction, no GPU-hours. This registration is that bid. Coordinate
check: the store WRITE rule is a spent coordinate; read-time selection over a fixed store has never been tested
in this project — every prior arm used the same untouched read path (v97_store.answer_two_hop: HRR unbind +
cosine cleanup-argmax over all stored objects, two hops).

**Confounds NAMED now (rule 2):** (a) the dump's aggregate outcomes are already known to me from V-109 scoring —
mitigated by fixing every rule and every bar in this entry with ZERO free parameters (no threshold, no weighting
constant, nothing sweepable) before writing any code; (b) a "frequency-weighted symbolic read" would change two
things at once vs the banked HRR path (symbolic traversal AND frequency) — controlled by a registered
symbolic-first control arm (R0) that isolates the frequency contribution.

**Mechanism, exact (discipline 4).** All arms are pure re-reads of the SAME union store (greedy ∪ m>=1, built by
v109.py's committed store logic, contents deterministic given the dump); generation, rows (300), seeds
(extract_ft_10k_{42,123,456}), normalisation norm(), and EM are untouched. cnt(s,o) := number of generations
(greedy pass + 8 samples, counted once per generation) containing a triple with normalised subject s and object o.
- **R0 control — symbolic-first:** two-hop symbolic walk, at each hop take the FIRST stored object for the
  current subject (exactly the s2 path answer_two_hop already computes). Isolates traversal change alone.
- **R1 PRIMARY — frequency read:** two-hop symbolic walk, at each hop take argmax over cnt(cur, o) among stored
  objects o for cur; ties broken by the existing HRR cleanup cosine for that hop, then first occurrence. If cur
  has no stored outgoing edge, that hop falls back to the banked HRR hop over the full store.
- **R2 SECONDARY — agreement-gated fallback (zero parameters):** emit the union-store answer iff the union store's
  own HRR and symbolic walks agree (the `agreed` flag answer_two_hop already returns); else emit the greedy-store
  HRR answer.
- **ORACLE (headroom, not a mechanism):** EM upper bound for ANY read rule = 1 iff a two-hop path head -> o1 ->
  answer exists in the union store under norm() matching.

**Bars (3-seed means), fixed now:**
- **P1 gate:** offline recomputation of EM(greedy-HRR) and EM(union-HRR) from the dump must reproduce the banked
  V-109 per-seed values EXACTLY (EM is a mean of 0/1 rows). Mismatch = offline harness broken, nothing is read.
  (Codebook RNG is device-sensitive; if P1 fails on CPU, rerun on an idle A800 GPU before declaring breakage.)
- **P2 headroom gate:** ORACLE-EM(union) >= EM(greedy) + .10 (>= .5856). FAIL = the union store does not contain

  still reported descriptively, labeled as such).
- **P3 PRIMARY:** EM(R1) >= EM(greedy) + .03 (>= .5156). HIT = first conversion of acquisition redundancy into
  end-to-end accuracy in this project, and the R1-minus-R0 gap must be reported alongside so the frequency
  contribution is not conflated with the traversal change. MISS with P2 pass = per-key relative frequency does
  not separate true from spurious objects at the competition point; combined with V-109's P2 fail (errors recur
  across samples), the extraction-redundancy family closes at BOTH loci (entry AND read) — the next bid must
  leave this family entirely. Record verbatim, no rescue iteration.
- **P4 SECONDARY:** EM(R2) >= EM(greedy) + .03. A P4 hit with a P3 miss does NOT rescue the line and no rule
  promotion occurs; it licenses at most ONE follow-up prereg that names why agreement gating works when

## 2026-09-04 — V-111 PRE-REGISTERED (before any code): does the V-95 cross-talk threshold (.0989) transfer from retrieval to analogical MAPPING? A causal grid on the Kanerva-2009 operations, zero training.

**Motivation and coordinate check.** V-110 closed the extraction-redundancy family at both loci and required
the next bid to leave that family entirely. The 2026-09-04 literature check NAMED this direction: Kleyko
Survey II leaves two open problems — holistic-transformation mapping "not demonstrated to be scalable to
large analogical episodes", and "lack of interaction and competition of consistent alternative mappings" —
and this project holds the instruments for both (the .0989 causal cross-talk threshold from V-95; the
cleanup-margin competition measurements from V-107/V-110). This is NOT the extraction store, NOT entry/read
selection, NOT a write rule, NOT a training signal: it is a causal measurement of a DIFFERENT VSA operation
(mapping) against a constant measured on retrieval. The lit-check's blocker (relation-slot store surgery)
is deliberately sidestepped: V-111 is a synthetic arena, not a store change; store surgery becomes a
candidate bid ONLY if P2 hits here. Contribution class per the lit check: MEASUREMENT, not phenomenon —
mapping itself is Plate/Kanerva/DRAMA/SBDR prior art and is cited as such.

**Mechanism, exact (discipline 4).** HRR algebra verbatim from the banked v97_store.py (circular convolution
bind via FFT; correlation-with-involution unbind; cosine cleanup-argmax over an explicit codebook; the
0.5/sqrt(n) abstention floor is NOT used here — every query has a target in-codebook, cleanup always answers).
Fresh i.i.d. unit-normalised random vectors per episode; codebook per episode = its own fillers plus
distractors to a fixed size C=256. Two registered tasks, generalising Kanerva 2009 §Dollar-of-Mexico and the
grandmother rule:
- **T1 (holistic substitution):** records V = sum_i r_i * f_i^V and M = sum_i r_i * f_i^M over the SAME n
  roles with disjoint filler sets. Query filler f_j^V; answer = cleanup( M * unbind(V, f_j^V) ) — the
  role-free composition Kanerva shows; correct iff argmax = f_j^M.
- **T2 (rule mapping, one-shot):** rule R = unbind(G_xz, (M_xy + F_yz)) computed from ONE example episode
  with novel entities; applied to a fresh antecedent (new entities, same relation structure); correct iff
  cleanup(R * antecedent) = the consequent. The registered configurations include the case Kanerva NAMES as
  failing (a relation that is part of the antecedent — the tautology competitor — outscoring the correct
  inference); reproducing that failure is part of the gate, not an embarrassment.
- **Cross-talk statistic chi(cell):** mean over queries of the mean absolute cosine between the pre-cleanup
  output vector and the non-target codebook entries — the realised-cross-talk quantity of V-95's table. The
  scorer must anchor this definition against the banked instrument (P1b) before any grid cell is read.

**Grid (fixed now):** d in {512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192}; n (pairs per record) in {2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128};
C=256 fixed (disclosed confound: codebook size co-determines cleanup difficulty; held constant so chi is the
only dial); 200 episodes per cell; seeds {42, 123, 456}. T2 runs at the same d-grid with its Kanerva-sized
episodes plus an n-scaled variant (antecedent of n conjuncts). Zero training; CPU (FFT convolution) or one
idle A800 GPU, GPU 1 left free.

**Bars (3-seed means), fixed now — zero free parameters anywhere:**
- **P1 gate (instrument + incumbent anchoring):** (a) at d=10000 in the small-n Kanerva regime, T1 and T2
  worked examples succeed >= .95 AND the named tautology failure reproduces in its registered configuration;
  (b) the V-95 synthetic harness re-run at injected cross-talk {0.0001, 0.0989} reproduces the banked
  accuracies {0.9244, 0.9033} within +-.01 (zero-training, re-runnable). Either sub-gate failing = harness
  broken, nothing is read.
- **P2 (PRIMARY — the transfer claim):** define per-cell success := accuracy >= floor + .10, floor = same-cell
  shuffled-target accuracy (empirical, zero parameters, V-95's criterion form). Over all T1 grid cells, the
  FIXED threshold chi <= 0.0989 classifies success with balanced accuracy >= .85; AND the best-fit threshold
  chi_fit lies within a factor of 2 of 0.0989 (i.e. in [0.0495, 0.1978]). HIT = one constant governs retrieval
  AND mapping in this algebra — the first cross-operation invariant in the project, and the licence to bid on
  relation-typed store surgery. MISS = the threshold is operation-specific; the "one constant" reading dies;
  record verbatim, no refit promotion, no rescue.
- **P3 (SECONDARY — the competition instrument):** in boundary cells (those with .2 <= accuracy <= .9), the
  per-query cleanup margin (cos_top1 - cos_top2) predicts per-query correctness with AUROC >= .75; AND on T2's
  registered tautology configurations the modal error IS the tautology competitor. Speaks directly to the
  survey's "competition among consistent alternative mappings" problem with a quantitative handle.
- **P4 (sufficiency model):** across d, cells matched on chi within +-.01 have median |delta accuracy| <= .05
  — chi, not (n,d) separately, is the sufficient statistic. Registered as a bar, tolerance fixed now.
- **No other threshold, task variant, or statistic may be scored.** Temptations recorded, nothing run.

**Expectations, stated separately from the bars (V-108..V-110 practice):** P1 pass. P2 genuinely uncertain
with a registered lean: T1 composes TWO unbinds, so noise should compound and push the effective threshold
BELOW .0989 — my lean is chi_fit < .0989 but inside the factor-2 band, i.e. a weak HIT; the live alternative
(outside the band => MISS) is exactly what would kill the one-constant story and is worth knowing either way.
P3 lean HIT (margin has predicted correctness in every arena where we measured it). P4 lean HIT.

**Confounds NAMED (rule 2):** (a) success-bar circularity — killed by the empirical shuffled-target floor;
(b) I know V-95's curve shape and the threshold value — mitigated by fixing every bar and tolerance in this
entry with zero sweepable constants before code; (c) C confounds cleanup difficulty — held fixed and
disclosed, a C-sweep is a separate prereg if ever wanted; (d) T2's one-shot rule quality depends on the
example episode's own cross-talk — measured and reported per-cell, not tuned.

**Prior-art scoping now, not after:** analogical retrieval and mapping in VSA are Plate 1995/2003, Kanerva
2009, DRAMA (Eliasmith), SBDR (Rachkovskij et al.); capacity theory is Frady 2018 and Clarkson et al. 2023
(set-membership bounds, different task). Any positive result is a claim about WHERE these operations sit
relative to a measured noise budget, never about the novelty of the operations. If P2 hits, the survey-gap
connection is the discussion paragraph, not a novelty claim.

**Budget:** one script v111.py + scorer v111_score.py, BOTH committed before the grid is run (discipline 1);
CPU-feasible (est. < 1 h; hard cap one tick of compute, background nohup if longer). Nothing enters the 9/16
manuscript regardless of outcome, per standing rule. Escalation counter: this registration names a new
coordinate; counter remains 0/6.

## 2026-09-04 — V-112 PRE-REGISTERED before any code: is Kanerva's named tautology failure ALGEBRA-SPECIFIC? (the V-111 confound, named per that closure's mandate; rule-2 rescue with the confound named; fresh episodes, the V-111 grid stays unread)

**Source verification done THIS tick (primary source, not memory):** Kanerva 2009, Cognitive Computation
1(2):139-159, p.154, "Learning to Infer by Holistic Mapping." Verbatim: "Things work out here because the
relations in the antecedent and the consequent are different. However, some of them could be the same.
Examples of such include (1) 'if x is the mother of y and y is a brother of z (and not half-brother) then x
is the mother of z,' and the transitive relation (2) 'if x is a brother of y and y is a brother of z
(different from x) then x is a brother of z.' When these are encoded in the same way as the mother-son-baby
example above and the resulting rule applied to a, b, and c, the computed inference correlates positively
with the correct inference but a relation that is a part of the antecedent—a tautology—correlates more
highly; in both cases 'b is a brother of c' wins over the intended conclusion about a's relation to c. An
analysis shows the reason for the failure. It shows that the mapping rule includes the identity vector,
which then takes the antecedent into the computed inference."

**THE NAMED CONFOUND (deciding V-111's reading (i) vs (ii)): algebra mistranslation = gate mis-spec,
reading (ii), now with a mechanism.** Kanerva's claim is stated for XOR/BSC SELF-INVERSE binding ("With XOR
as the multiplication operator, the mapping is effected by the product-vector R_xyz = G_xz * (M_xy +
F_yz)", p.154; encoding M_xy = M1*X + M2*Y with PER-RELATION role vectors, p.154). In exact self-inverse
algebra the conjunct shared between consequent and antecedent cancels to the EXACT, noise-free identity —
that is his stated mechanism. The banked HRR correlation-unbind is NOT self-inverse (his own 2010 AAAI
paper: "Unlike XOR that is a self-inverse, the binding operator and its inverse are different in both real
and complex HRR"); the analogous identity component x (*) invol(x) is an autocorrelation whose sidelobe
self-noise has norm comparable to its spike, so dominance need not transfer. V-111's observed near-parity
(taut 284 vs correct 315) is what an attenuated-but-present identity component predicts. SECOND disclosed
divergence: v111.py encodes relation instances as P conv (R1 conv a + R2 conv b) (shared roles, relation
bound multiplicatively) — Kanerva's is a per-relation role SUM with no outer relation binding. v111.py's
taut configuration DOES structurally match his case (1) (consequent shares relation AND slot-1 filler with
conjunct 1), so the harness computed what was registered; the REGISTRATION mistranslated an algebra-specific
claim into a different algebra and a different encoding. V-111's P1 gate was mis-specified, not the harness
faulty — that is the registered hypothesis; V-112 tests it rather than asserts it.

**Design (fresh episodes; the V-111 grid is NOT rescored):** d = 10000 ONLY (the regime of Kanerva's claim).
FOUR arms = {BSC, HRR} x {Kanerva encoding, v111 rec() encoding}; TWO cases = his (1) mother/brother->mother
and (2) transitive brother, both with the entity-sharing structure verbatim; 1000 episodes per (arm, case,
seed); seeds {42, 123, 456}. BSC: i.i.d. Bernoulli(1/2) bits, bind = XOR, bundle = majority with random
ties (his construction), similarity = 1 - 2*hamming/d. HRR: the banked v97_store algebra generalised in d
exactly as v111.py did (bit-fidelity assert at d=2048 at import). Kanerva encoding: instance = normalize(
Rel1 bind a + Rel2 bind b), per-relation role vectors all distinct. v111 encoding: rec() verbatim from
v111.py. Rule = consequent unbound by the bundled antecedent (XOR product in BSC; banked correlation-unbind
in HRR); applied to a fresh antecedent over new entities. Readout identical to V-111: 12 candidates = 3
relations x 4 ordered pairs [(x2,z2),(x2,y2),(y2,z2),(z2,x2)] encoded in the arm's own encoding; kinds
correct / taut (the two antecedent-conjunct instances) / other. Zero training, CPU, est. minutes.

**Registered statistics (fixed now):** tw = per-episode pairwise win rate P[ sim(second-conjunct candidate)
> sim(correct candidate) ] (his named winner 'b R c' is the SECOND conjunct); mw = modal-argmax rate of kind
taut; idc = mean cos(rule vector, algebra identity) (BSC bipolar identity = all-+1s; HRR identity = delta
e_0). All 3-seed means, both cases reported separately, a bar must hold on BOTH cases.

**Bars (zero free parameters beyond the constants fixed in this entry):**
- **P1 gate (incumbent reproduction on his own terms):** BSC x Kanerva-encoding arm: tw >= .75 AND modal
  argmax kind = taut in BOTH cases. ".75" is my disclosed reading of his unquantified "wins"; fixed now.

**Expectations, separate from bars (V-108..V-111 practice):** P1 pass — LEAN ONLY, genuinely uncertain

## 2026-09-04 ~08:00Z — V-114 PRE-REGISTRATION (committed BEFORE any code): what governs mapping accuracy — the DECISION-POINT SNR hypothesis

**Motivation (from V-113 P4, the one live registered-quality question):** T1 cells matched on chi (mean |cos|
of a SINGLE unbind's output against non-targets) differ in mapping accuracy by a median 44 points. chi
measures NOISE ONLY, and measures it ONE OPERATION UPSTREAM of the decision. Named physical hypothesis: T1
composes TWO chained unbinds; chaining both ATTENUATES THE SIGNAL (cosine to the correct target) and
reshapes the noise, and the two move differently across (d, n) — a noise-only upstream scalar cannot see
this. The candidate coordinate is therefore the signal-to-noise ratio measured ON THE COMPOSED VECTOR THE
PIPELINE ACTUALLY SCORES.

**Candidate statistic (named, SINGLE — no alternate may be scored):**
snr_map := per-cell mean over queries of [ cos(v_q, x_target) − mean_j |cos(v_q, x_j)| ] / std_j(cos(v_q, x_j)),
where v_q is the exact composed vector T1 hands to cleanup, x_target the true target (harness-known), and j
ranges over the C−1 non-target cleanup items; per-query, then cell-averaged; denominator floored at 1e-6
(disclosed).

**Design:** fresh disjoint seeds (fourth disjoint block); same T1 grid axes and C=256 as V-111/V-113 (held
fixed, disclosed — a C-sweep still needs its own prereg); T2 NOT in scope (transfer line closed). v114.py =
v113.py + snr_map instrumentation, T1 only; v114_score.py committed before the run; launch record checksums
every imported module vs the commit (V-110 standing rule).

**Bars — conjunctive gate, then four readings:**
- **P1 GATE (carried verbatim from V-113's corrected gate, T1 parts):** v95 anchors within ±.01 of banked
  {.9244, .9033}; fresh-episode worked example T1 ≥ .95. Gate fails ⇒ nothing is read.
- **P2 (PRIMARY — sufficiency, the exact bar chi failed):** across all cross-d T1 cell pairs matched on
  snr_map within ±10% relative, median |Δaccuracy| ≤ .05. Requires ≥ 20 matched pairs, else P2 is
  UNSCORABLE (reported, not passed — the V-111 clause). HIT = mapping accuracy is governed by
  decision-point SNR. MISS = no scalar of this family governs mapping; the line CLOSES verbatim.
- **P3 (predictive, held-out):** order T1 cells lexicographically by (d, n); fit ONE snr_map threshold on
  EVEN-indexed cells (geomean-of-best-split-boundary, v113_score.py's registered procedure); score balanced
  accuracy on ODD-indexed cells against the same shuffled-target-floor+.10 success definition; bar ≥ .85.
- **P4 (comparative — guards a vacuous P2):** median |Δacc| at matched snr_map must be ≤ HALF the median
  |Δacc| at matched chi (chi matched at ±.01, the banked tolerance) on the SAME grid.

**Consequences fixed now:** P2 HIT + P3 HIT ⇒ banked sentence "mapping accuracy is governed by the SNR of
the composed vector at the decision point, not by upstream cross-talk"; contribution class MEASUREMENT;
nothing enters the 9/16 manuscript. P2 MISS ⇒ the mapping-governance line is CLOSED — no rescue, no
alternate statistic scored, no refit promotion in any branch; the next tick then faces the new-coordinate
test or the escalation counter starts.

**Confounds NAMED (rule 2):** (a) CONTAMINATION — I have seen V-113's P4 spread and its descriptive
per-cell lines; the risk is designing a statistic to fit a seen grid. Mitigations: fresh disjoint seeds; the
candidate was already named in V-113's recorded temptation list ("composed-unbind SNR") before this prereg;
no V-113 number is transcribed into any bar. (b) NEAR-TAUTOLOGY — snr_map uses the true target and the same
cosines cleanup uses, so P3 alone would be weak evidence; that is WHY the PRIMARY bar is P2 (cross-d
sufficiency, a structural claim chi failed at .4358) and P4 demands a factor-2 margin over chi rather than
absolute performance. (c) denominator instability — floored, disclosed. (d) C=256 co-determines cleanup
difficulty — held fixed as before.

**Expectations (separate from bars, standing practice):** P1 pass lean. P2 HIT lean — tempered by the 1/4
audit at V-113 (my priors were retrieval-shaped); a MISS would say mapping accuracy is not even a function
of decision-point cosine geometry, which is the more surprising and more valuable sentence. P3 HIT lean.
P4 HIT lean (weak).

**Budget:** CPU only, est. < 1 h, nohup background, hold-one-tick rule if it finishes < 30 min before a

### 2026-09-04 — MECHANISM CHECK on V-108: where the removed error actually lives. A manuscript sentence DEFENDED, and an uncomfortable reading of our own decomposition.

**Why this was run.** Asked why any error remains for a frontier model to remove, I could not answer without
excluding the obvious harness artefact: the single_pass arm reads the instance's own passages under a 1200-token
budget, so if `build_context` truncates the needed passage then the arms do NOT receive the same evidence and the
manuscript's own framing — "the dataset supplies gold evidence triples and every answer appears among them
(coverage 1.000), so the arms differ only in HOW the same evidence reaches the model" — would be wrong, and the
error-removal denominator would be inflated by evidence starvation rather than by composition failure.

**Measured on the same 300 validation rows, Qwen3-8B tokenizer, budget 1200 (the V-108 protocol):**
```
context TRUNCATED                 0 / 300  (0.0%)
ANSWER STRING absent from context 0 / 300  (0.0%)
some gold SUBJECT absent          21 / 300 (7.0%)
some gold OBJECT absent           0 / 300  (0.0%)
```
**The sentence is defended.** Nothing truncates at this budget and the answer string is literally present in the
context on every row, so single_pass at .2800–.4800 is not an evidence-availability failure. The model holds the
answer and gets it wrong 52–72% of the time.

**So the error is in composition over prose, and the contrast isolates it.** The same model, on the same two
facts, jumps from .2800 to .9333 (glm-5) and .4767 to .9900 (deepseek-v4-flash) when the facts arrive as clean
triples instead of paragraphs. No parameters, no knowledge, no reading ability changed — only the form of the
evidence. What the passages demand and the triples do not: identifying which two of ~10 Wikipedia paragraphs
matter, traversing an intermediate entity **the question never names**, and resisting eight paragraphs of
distractors, with a first-hop error propagating silently.

**Scale does not buy it, and the ladder says so directly**: glm-5 (.2800) and qwen3.5-397b-a17b (.3600) are the
two WORST single_pass scores of all ten rungs.

**The uncomfortable reading, recorded because it follows from our own decomposition.** Splitting the gain:
prose → clean triples is worth +51 to +65 points at frontier scale, while clean triples → exact algebra is worth
store .974 against evidence_in_prompt .8863–.9900. The manuscript already says as much for Phi-2 — "Most of the
gain is evidence access: 70 of the 72 points are available in-context" — and the ten-rung ladder shows the second
term **shrinking to zero and inverting** (deepseek-v4-flash .9900 > store .974, which is the P3 failure seen from
the mechanism side). So the honest statement of what this work contributes is: **structuring the evidence is worth
almost all of it; composing it exactly is a small and scale-shrinking increment.** What survives at frontier scale
is not accuracy but the two things a language model cannot offer at any size — the constructive guarantee that the
output is an entity of the store, and the cost profile (V-106: .0596 s against 11,612 tokens and .827 s).

**Minor finding, relevant to the acquisition half.** On 7.0% of rows a gold triple's SUBJECT surface form does not
appear verbatim in the context (aliases, spelling variants), while gold OBJECTS always do. This does not affect
answer availability but it is a surface-form gap between the gold triples and the passages, and it is part of why
end-to-end extraction recall sits at .66 (V-98) rather than near 1.

(cells with snr > 0.05), rounded to integer, unreachable targets dropped:
- d=512:  n = {15, 13, 11, 9, 7, 6, 4}            (S=0.40 unreachable)
- d=1024: n = {24, 21, 19, 17, 14, 11, 8, 6}
- d=2048: n = {31, 26, 22, 19, 16, 12, 9}          (S=0.40 unreachable)
- d=4096: n = {48, 42, 37, 33, 27, 22, 17, 14}
- d=8192: n = {58, 48, 39, 32, 25, 20}             (S=0.40, 0.55 unreachable)
36 cells x 3 fresh seeds = 108 seed-cells (same size as V-114). T1 only, C=256 held fixed, task machinery =
v114.py's verbatim (v115.py differs ONLY in the (d,n) cell list and seed block). Seeds: FIFTH disjoint block.
Forward-interpolated snr error at the rounded n is <= 8.7% on every cell; the calibration predicts **65**
cross-d pairs inside the +-10% relative window — 3x the registered floor, the margin that makes this powered.

**DESIGN-CONTAMINATION DISCLOSURE (rule 2, named in full).** To build this grid I read v114_logs/v114.json
per-cell snr and acc values (banked, already-scored data). They were used ONLY to choose (d,n) coordinates and
to estimate pair yield; no bar, threshold, tolerance, or success definition is transcribed from them — every
bar below predates this read (V-114 prereg 8223a4b). All V-115 measurements come from fresh disjoint seeds.
The specific risk — picking cells where the hypothesis happens to look good — is bounded by P2's structure:
sufficiency is scored on WHATEVER pairs the fresh run yields, and the grid was chosen for snr alignment, not
for accuracy agreement (accuracy values played no role in cell selection beyond the ladder spanning the
transition region 0.4–3.5 that V-113/V-114 already established as the informative band).

**Bars — carried VERBATIM from V-114 (prereg 8223a4b), procedure = v114_score.py's registered procedures:**
- **P1 GATE:** v95 anchors within +-.01 of banked {.9244, .9033}; fresh-episode worked example T1 >= .95.
  Gate fails => nothing is read.
- **P2 (PRIMARY):** across all cross-d T1 cell pairs matched on snr_map within +-10% relative, median
  |dacc| <= .05; requires >= 20 matched pairs else UNSCORABLE.
- **P3 (held-out threshold):** one snr_map threshold fit on even-indexed cells (lexicographic (d,n) order,
  geomean-of-best-split), balanced accuracy on odd-indexed cells >= .85, success = shuffled-target floor +.10.
- **P4 (comparative):** median |dacc| at matched snr_map <= HALF the median |dacc| at matched chi (+-.01) on
  the SAME grid.

**Consequences fixed now:** P2 HIT + P3 HIT => banked sentence "mapping accuracy is governed by the SNR of the
composed vector at the decision point, not by upstream cross-talk"; contribution class MEASUREMENT; nothing
enters the 9/16 manuscript. P2 MISS => the mapping-governance line is CLOSED verbatim — no rescue, no alternate
statistic, no refit. **P2 UNSCORABLE AGAIN (despite the 3x powering margin) => the line RESTS PERMANENTLY as
directional-only (V-114 P3/P4 stand as the final word); no third powering attempt.** Priors on record from
V-114: threshold .7690 (held-out bal acc 1.0000), 11-pair median |dacc| .0067.

**Confounds NAMED:** (a) pair density — the confound this prereg powers against (65 predicted vs 20 required);
(b) design contamination — disclosed in full above; (c) integer rounding of n shifts realized snr off-target
(<= 8.7% predicted; the +-10% window is part of the registered bar and unchanged); (d) per-seed snr spread
(~+-5% at low snr in V-114) may cut pair yield below prediction — covered by the 3x margin, and the UNSCORABLE
consequence above makes even that outcome terminal rather than open; (e) C=256 co-determines cleanup
difficulty — held fixed, a C-sweep still needs its own prereg.

**Expectations (separate from bars):** P1 pass lean. P2 HIT lean (V-114's P3/P4 directional evidence).

## 2026-09-04 ~11:35Z — V-116 PREREGISTERED (BEFORE any code): gold-free decision-point SNR as an ONLINE mapping-abstention signal — the first instrument-to-mechanism step on the mapping-governance line

**Candidate selection (from V-115's registered next-decision list).** Three candidates were on record:
(i) C-sweep, (ii) read-side traversal (new generation config), (iii) online snr_map as a mapping-abstention
signal. This prereg registers (iii): it is the highest-information step (turns the V-115 MEASUREMENT into a
usable mechanism if it works; closes cleanly if it does not), and the V-115 verdict itself named it "the
first instrument-to-mechanism step on this line." (i) and (ii) remain live and unregistered; confound (e)
(C=256 fixed) is inherited here unchanged and explicitly NOT addressed by this experiment.

**The gap this prereg must not blur.** The banked snr_map (prereg 8223a4b, v114.py:84) is
snr_q = [cos(v_q, x_target) − mean_j |cos(v_q, x_j)|] / std_j(cos(v_q, x_j)) — it uses the GOLD target and
is therefore NOT computable at inference time. The registered online statistic is the gold-free plug-in:
**snr_hat = [cos(v_q, x_top1) − mean_{j≠top1} |cos(v_q, x_j)|] / std_{j≠top1}(cos(v_q, x_j))**,
computed from the pipeline's own competition vector sims, no gold anywhere. By construction snr_hat = snr_q
(up to the excluded-index set) on CORRECT episodes; the entire question is whether it SEPARATES on WRONG
episodes — exactly where margin (top1−top2) already FAILED (V-113 P3: AUROC .647 vs bar .75, first
predictive failure of cleanup margin on record). A statistic that merely re-fails like margin closes the
line; the bars below therefore require BEATING margin head-to-head on identical episodes, not just clearing
an absolute bar.

**Arena.** Mixed-episode stream over T1 mapping episodes spanning BOTH sides of the snr_map governance
threshold, cells drawn from the banked V-114/V-115 (d, n) curves (design-read of banked numbers to place
the mixture — disclosed here, same class of disclosure as V-115's aligned ladder). C=256, HRR pipeline
unchanged (v97_store.py repaired blob, v95/v13 imports — full import-closure checksums in the launch record
per the V-110 standing rule). Fresh SIXTH disjoint seed block {17, 171, 1717} (disjoint from all of
V-111..115). CPU only, GPUs untouched, nohup under flock, est. < 1 h.

**Calibration probe (discipline 3, registered as part of the protocol, run BEFORE the full stream):**
single seed, short budget: the mixture must yield pooled mapping accuracy in [.30, .85] AND ≥ 100 wrong
episodes at probe scale (scaling to ≥ 400 predicted wrong episodes in the full run). If the probe fails
either side, the cell mixture may be re-weighted ONCE, BEFORE the full run, with the re-weighting recorded
in the launch record; after the full run is launched the mixture is frozen and no re-weighting is permitted.
Probe reads pooled accuracy and wrong-count ONLY (no snr_hat/AUROC values — the probe must not preview the
verdict statistic).

**Bars (all fixed now; scorer to be committed BEFORE the run; per-episode dump so the scorer is the only
reader):**
- **P1 GATE (carried, conjunctive):** v95 anchors c=0.0/0.1 within .01 of banked; fresh worked example
  T1 ≥ .95. FAIL ⇒ nothing else is read.
- **P2 PRIMARY (predictive separation):** pooled AUROC(snr_hat → episode correctness) over the full mixed
  stream ≥ **.80** AND ≥ AUROC(margin) + **.10** on the IDENTICAL episode set (margin = top1−top2 from the
  same sims vector — the V-113-failed incumbent, the real one, not a strawman). UNSCORABLE clause (V-114
  pair-density lesson, power the denominator explicitly): if the full run yields < **200** wrong episodes
  pooled, P2 is UNSCORABLE and the line RESTS as unresolved — only a scored MISS closes it.
  **MISS ⇒ the abstention line CLOSES: gold-free decision-point SNR is not an online mapping-abstention
  signal; the V-115 governance result stays measurement-only. No rescue, no alternative statistic swapped
  in post hoc.**
- **P3 (operating point, independent):** threshold on snr_hat fit on even-indexed episodes only; on
  odd-indexed episodes, selective accuracy ≥ **.95** at coverage ≥ **.50**. (Selective accuracy = accuracy
  on non-abstained episodes; coverage = fraction non-abstained.)
- **P4 (comparative vs config-oracle, the named kill for "adds nothing"):** AUROC(snr_hat) must exceed
  AUROC(config predictor) by ≥ **.05**, where the config predictor assigns each episode its CELL-MEAN
  gold snr_map (an oracle that knows the (d, n) cell but not the episode). If the config oracle matches
  snr_hat, per-episode online estimation adds nothing over knowing the configuration — recorded as MISS.
- **P5 (mixture-confound control, descriptive gate on P2):** per-cell AUROC(snr_hat) reported for every
  cell with ≥ 30 wrong episodes; if pooled P2 passes while the MEDIAN per-cell AUROC < .65, the pooled
  number is flagged as mixture-driven (Simpson) and the P2 sentence is NOT licensed (P2 recorded as
  MISS-by-control). This is the V-114-P3 near-tautology caveat promoted to a registered control.

**Confounds NAMED:** (a) plug-in coupling — snr_hat ≡ snr_q on correct episodes by construction; only
wrong-episode separation is informative, which P2's AUROC and the wrong-episode floor address; (b) the
margin precedent — snr_hat is a normalized cousin of margin and may inherit its failure; the +.10
head-to-head bar makes "re-fails like margin" a clean CLOSE; (c) mixture composition can manufacture pooled
AUROC (Simpson) — P5 control; (d) cell design-read from banked curves — disclosed; (e) C=256 co-determines
cleanup difficulty — held fixed, still needs its own prereg; (f) probe-then-run re-weighting could leak —
bounded to ONE pre-launch re-weighting, recorded, verdict statistics never read at probe time.

**Expectations (separate from bars, honest lean):** P1 pass. **P2 lean MISS** — on wrong episodes the
top-1 substitution biases snr_hat upward the same way it biases margin, and V-113's margin failure is the
closest measured precedent; a HIT would be the surprising, more valuable sentence. P3 conditional on P2's
region. P4 genuinely open. This is the reverse of the V-115 lean set; recorded so the audit is checkable.

**Consequences fixed:** P2 HIT + P5 clean ⇒ banked sentence candidate: "decision-point SNR is estimable
without gold well enough to act as an online mapping-abstention signal, where cleanup margin is not."

Frady/Kleyko/Sommer 2018 eqs 13-14: classification accuracy at WTA readout is a single-equation
function of the decision-point signal-to-noise ratio s = sqrt(N)(mu_d' - mu_d)/sigma_d, with crosstalk
from other stored items as CLT-Gaussian noise — our snr_map is exactly this class of statistic. Their
analyzed scope (TOC + Sec 2.1-2.2) is RETRIEVAL from superpositions (classification/detection,
sequence memory, channel capacity); holistic MAPPING/substitution is not treated. The Neumann 2002 /
Plate transformation line learns mappings but states no accuracy law. CONSEQUENCE (discipline 5,
applied to our own framing): S3 must be REFRAMED from discovery to measured EXTENSION — "the Frady
et al. decision-point-SNR law, established for retrieval from superpositions, extends empirically to
Kanerva-style holistic mapping; the retrieval constant chi does not transfer" — the novelty is the
extension + the cross-coordinate non-transfer (V-113+V-115 jointly), not SNR governance itself.
Retro-note: the theory is gold-aware; nothing in it promises gold-free per-episode estimability, so
the V-116 close (snr_hat = configuration detector) sits comfortably beside it.
